newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan hijack suspect detained by China police.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan hijack suspect detained by China police.

text.p: A jobless journalist suspected of hijacking of a Taiwan civilian aircraft to China on Monday was detained by mainland authorities moments after the plane touched down at Xiamen, Taiwan authorities said.
"He was taken away by mainland public security authorities," Lee Yun-ning, general manager of Far East Air Transport, whose Boeing 757 was involved in the incident, said in Taiwan.
Lee said the plane was likely to return almost immediately.
"We hope that the plane can fly back to Taiwan within one hour," Lee said at a news briefing.

Lee said 150 passengers and six crew were still aboard the plane that was commandeered shortly after departing the southern Taiwan port city of Kaohsiung on a scheduled flight to Taipei. He said the plane was being refuelled at Xiamen in China's southeastern Fujian province for the return flight.

"We already have had contact with Taiwan affairs officials in Beijing and have received authorisation for the plane to return to Taiwan," Lee said. "The matter now is in the hands of the local authorities in Xiamen."
